versions.text: (a) Except as provi ded i n sub-paragraph (e), each forward and rear position light m ust, as installed, show unbroken l ight within the dihedral angles described in this paragraph. (e) If t he rear posi tion l ight, when mounted as far aft as practicable in accordance with CS 29.1385(c), cannot show unbroken l ight within dihedral angle A (as defined in sub-paragraph (d)), a solid an gle o r an gles o f o bstructed v isibility totalling not m ore t han 0.04 steradians is allowable within that dihedral an gle, if su ch so lid angle is with in a co ne w hose apex is at the rear position l ight and whose el ements m ake an angle of 30° with a vertical line passing through the rear position light.
